text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing! Power is welling up inside 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It feels like someone is cheering me on... 
Could it really be the Three Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. In that case, I'll have to do my 
best to live up to those expectations!
